mapper.select: SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as CREATED_DATE, TO_CHAR(CONTENT) as CONTENT FROM BOARD ORDER BY BOARD_ID DESC
SELECT BOARD_ID, TITLE, WRITER, VIEW_COUNT, TO_CHAR(CREATED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') as CREATED_DATE, TO_CHAR(CONTENT) AS CONTENT FROM BOARD WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
SELECT FILE_ID, BOARD_ID, ORIGINAL_NAME, FILE_SIZE, FILE_PATH FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE BOARD_ID = #{boardId}
SELECT ORIGINAL_NAME, STORED_NAME, FILE_PATH FROM BOARD_FILE WHERE FILE_ID = #{fileId}
